subject: System architecture deep-dive — reading dossier, diagrams, and calendar collision
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@acme.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudWorks Ops <ops@cloudworks.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: system architecture deep-dive (preferred week of Nov 8)

Diego, Laura, Stephanie —

Thanks for agreeing to run a technical deep-dive with our infra team. We are aiming for the week of Nov 8 to walk through your runtime, routing/fallback, and the KV cache approach. High level asks from our side:
- A short agenda so we can align internal reviewers
- Any topology/sequence diagrams (especially token flow / cache hit example)
- A reading packet or short doc so folks can skim before the session

We have an internal constraint on Nov 9 between 10:00–11:30 PT. Proposed windows that work on our side: Nov 8 (14:00–15:30 PT), Nov 10 (09:00–10:30 PT), Nov 11 (16:00–17:30 PT).

Could you send an initial agenda and any material you can — even a rough diagram — and we’ll confirm a slot.

Appreciate it,
Mateo
Principal Infra Eng, Acme Corp
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@acme.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: system architecture deep-dive (preferred week of Nov 8)

Mateo — thanks, and good constraints to know. I attached our initial reading dossier and a topology PDF so your team can scan before the session. Quick proposed outline (30–45m + Q&A):

1) 5m — introductions and goals (Diego)
2) 10m — serving runtime overview and kernel selection (Laura)
3) 10m — routing, fallback policies, and SLO mapping (Jonas)
4) 10m — KV cache and batching heuristics + token flow (Stephanie)
5) 5–10m — open Q&A and next steps

Attachments included: arch-deep-dive-agenda.docx, 20261104-system-topology-v2.pdf, reading-dossier-v1.md. I also put a sequence diagram (sequence-diagram.png) that shows an example cache hit vs miss path.

From a calendar perspective we can host Nov 8 14:00–15:00 PT or Nov 10 09:00–10:00 PT. If neither work we have a late slot on Nov 11 at 16:00 PT. I’ll leave the final selection to you.

Link to folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cAcmeArchPack
Zoom provisional: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=archdeepdive

Will also bring a short checklist of follow-up artifacts we can share after the call.

Best,
Diego
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo@acme.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: System architecture deep-dive — reading dossier, diagrams, and calendar collision

Diego / Mateo — quick note: I’m booked on Nov 8 afternoon in a leadership offsite that was moved last week. I can present the kernel selection and runtime overview but only on Nov 10 or the Nov 11 late slot.

If Nov 10 09:00 PT works for Acme, I’ll swap my talk order so we keep the flow: I can still do the runtime piece and Jonas can cover routing/fallback. Otherwise, I can prerecord a 6–8 minute screencast of the runtime slides and join Q&A live on Nov 11 if needed.

Diego — I reviewed the dossier quickly; I suggest we add a one-page appendix that highlights the cache eviction policy and an example latency table for 16k vs 4k sequences. I can draft that and add to the folder if you want me to.

-Laura
Staff ML Infra Engineer
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@acme.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 08:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: System architecture deep-dive — reading dossier, diagrams, and calendar collision

Laura — Nov 10 09:00 PT looks good for us. Prefer live walkthroughs if possible. Thanks for offering the appendix — that would be super helpful (eviction policy + latency table).

A couple of small asks before the session:
- Can you add a short example walkthrough (sequence-diagram.png) that annotates where we’d expect observable traces?
- If possible, include a short FAQ entry in the dossier about multi-tenant isolation and data retention (our compliance team will skim that).

We’ll lock Nov 10 09:00–10:00 PT and invite additional reviewers from security. Please send the final invite when you have it.

Mateo
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@acme.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 7 Nov 2026 18:42:00 -0800
Subject: Final: System architecture deep-dive — Nov 10 09:00 PT (agenda + materials)

Thanks all — booked Nov 10 09:00–10:00 PT. Final links and materials are in the Drive folder (same link). Quick changes since the draft:
- Laura added the appendix (cache eviction + latency table).
- I annotated sequence-diagram.png to show where traces / observability hooks should be instrumented.
- Added short FAQ section on multi-tenant isolation & retention in reading-dossier-v1.md.

Who’s presenting which section:
- Diego: intros + goals, closing next steps
- Laura: serving runtime & kernel selection
- Jonas: routing and fallback policies, SLO mapping
- Stephanie: KV cache + batching heuristics and token flow examples

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=arch-deepdive-acme-nov10
Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=archdeepdive
Attachments referenced: arch-deep-dive-agenda.docx, 20261104-system-topology-v2.pdf, reading-dossier-v1.md, sequence-diagram.png

Please let me know if you need additional artifacts before Tuesday. Otherwise we’ll run the walkthrough and capture action items for follow-up.

Diego
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
